Reg-ARIMA Model

Source: R/models.R
REGARIMA.Rd

Defines a Reg-ARIMA model (the pre-adjustment model used in X-13), without seasonal adjustment, to be used inside fabletools::model(). The model is estimated with rjd3x13::jregarima() and the Java result is kept in the fitted model. Arguments and specials are the same as for X13(), except x11(), seats() and benchmarking(), which do not apply and are ignored with a warning.

Usage

REGARIMA(
  formula,
  spec = c("rg4", "rg0", "rg1", "rg2c", "rg3", "rg5c"),
  context = NULL,
  ref_spec = spec,
  ...
)

Arguments

formula

Model formula: the name of the variable to adjust (y), or y ~ specials (see jd3_specials).

spec

Base specification: a character name (see rjd3x13::regarima_spec() for the available names; the default is the first one) or a specification object from rjd3x13::regarima_spec().

context

A modelling context created with rjd3toolkit::modelling_context() (e.g. for custom calendars), or NULL.

ref_spec

Reference specification stored in the model: it is the reference of the refresh policies used by refit() and stream(). Defaults to spec, that is the specification before its modification by the specials.

...

Currently unused.

Value

A model definition that can be passed to fabletools::model(). Once fitted, the mable column contains a jd3_model object.

Details

There is no decomposition, so components() is not available. The other methods are: fitted(), residuals(), forecast(), backcast(), outliers(), tidy(), glance() and report().

See also

X13(), TRAMO(), jd3_specials, jd3_model_methods

Examples

y <- tsibble::as_tsibble(AirPassengers)
mb <- model(y, regarima = REGARIMA(value))
tidy(mb)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 6
#>   .model   term         estimate std.error statistic  p.value
#>   <chr>    <chr>           <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1 regarima theta(1)     -0.116    0.109        -1.06 2.89e- 1
#> 2 regarima btheta(1)    -0.497    0.0723       -6.88 2.55e-10
#> 3 regarima td2          -0.00295  0.000533     -5.53 1.79e- 7
#> 4 regarima easter [1]    0.0178   0.00730       2.43 1.63e- 2
#> 5 regarima AO (1951-05)  0.100    0.0208        4.81 4.33e- 6
report(mb)
#> Series: value 
#> Model: REGARIMA, ARIMA(0,1,1)(0,1,1) 
#> Transformation: Log; N obs.: 144 
#> 
#> 
#> Coefficients
#>                Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
#> theta(1)     -0.1155344  0.1085487  -1.064   0.2892    
#> btheta(1)    -0.4974142  0.0722919  -6.881 2.55e-10 ***
#> td2          -0.0029497  0.0005334  -5.530 1.79e-07 ***
#> easter [1]    0.0177674  0.0072985   2.434   0.0163 *  
#> AO (1951-05)  0.1001562  0.0208399   4.806 4.33e-06 ***
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
#> 
#> Tests on residuals: Independence (Ljung-Box: Good, 0.354); Normality (Doornik-Hansen: Good, 0.683)

# Forecasts of the raw series
forecast(mb, h = 12)
#> # A fable: 12 x 4 [1M]
#> # Key:     .model [1]
#>    .model      index
#>    <chr>       <mth>

#>  2 regarima 1961 Feb
